page.text:
The pair construction now supplies every component of the abstract
integer tuple.  Its carrier is the quotient of $\mathbb{N} \times
\mathbb{N}$ by the relation above.  Addition adds like coordinates,
multiplication expands $(a-b)(c-d)$, negation swaps the coordinates,
and order compares the represented differences without using integer
subtraction.
